cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Help Me Keep This Quiet
cards.instruction: Get someone to help contain a secret without first revealing its full risk or purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm keeping my voice down like you. Good. Keep this cupboard key until tomorrow; don't tell your flatmate.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm hoarse. Tell me what's in the cupboard before I agree.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Save your voice. Nothing alive. Can you keep the key just for tonight?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you collect it before she gets home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. Text me when she leaves work. Just 'key', please.

reason: Replace stock confidence with a mistaken copied practical cue and a confident adaptation; maintain exact secrecy, explanation, concealment-apology, endorsement, or delegated-follow-up pursuit.
